title: How to Obtain Domicile / Residence Certificate
requiredDocuments: Continuous 7-year study certificate in Karnataka (signed by Block Education Officer - BEO)
Aadhaar Card and Ration Card of parents
Residential property tax receipt or electricity bill

steps.title: Document Collection and Counter-signature
steps.description: Collect study certificates from 1st standard to 10th/12th and get countersigned by jurisdictional BEO/DDPU.

steps.title: Seva Sindhu Online Submission
steps.description: Upload address proofs and countersigned study certificates on Seva Sindhu portal under Residence/Domicile service.

steps.title: Digital Approval
steps.description: Tahsildar issues digitally verified domicile certificate with unique RD tracking number.

validityPeriod: Life-time or as required by state scholarship portals.
